messages:
jonah_csm: Quick weekly check for Cascade (CSD-903)  trending above commit. Commit $8k/mo, projected runrate $11.6k based on 7-day trend. Anomaly flagged Tue 04:20 UTC for large batch window. Error rate stable but tokens-per-call jumped. Opening thread to coordinate cap/enablement/renewal risk. @billing-bot can you confirm runrate and top endpoints?

billing-bot: ALERT: Detected spend variance for customer Cascade (acct: CSD-903). Projected month runrate: $11,620. Commit: $8,000. Estimated overage: $3,620. Top traffic: /v1/embeddings (62%), /v1/generate (28%). Spike correlates with 03:45-05:00 UTC batch jobs from two client IP ranges. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/cascade/spend

fatima_csm: Scheduled customer sync Wed 10:00 PT. Theyre mid-onboarding  renewal risk if overage continues. Recommend offering an enablement session on batching + embeddings config and a short-term cost-mitigation plan. Can Finance weigh in on commit flexibility?

reno_eng: I'll pull batch logs and check for retry storms or stuck workers. If it's an SDK backfill behavior we can push a backoff/limit. Suggest edge throttle for non-interactive batch tokens for trial accounts. Example diagnostic: `redwood logs query --customer CSD-903 --filter "endpoint:/v1/embeddings" --since 48h`

ops-runner: Applied a soft notification-only cap at $9,500 (won't block calls). Notification sent to primary contacts. Cap auto-expires 2026-04-02T08:00Z unless updated. Documented in OPS-7722.

kevin_account_exec: Noted renewal risk. If overage > $2k we should consider a one-time courtesy credit + commit upsell. @billing-bot can you compute percent delta vs prior 7-day window?

billing-bot: RUN: 7-day comparison: tokens +85% vs prior week. If current trend holds, expected overage >25% of commit. Created reconciliation ticket FIN-7589.

marie_prod: We shipped server-side nearest-neighbor caching for embeddings last week which can cut token usage for repeated vectors. Do they perform client dedupe? If not, we can enable server-side duplicate suppression for Cascade as a quick win (opt-in). Estimated config change ETA ~30m.

jonah_csm: Customer confirmed they accidentally kicked off a large backfill and paused it upon our ping. I'll propose the enablement slot + the server-side dedupe toggle. Also flagging renewal team: customer sentiment fragile until costs stabilize.

reno_eng: Enabled server-side dedupe for Cascade test bucket. Early sample: tokens down ~40% for deduped runs. Monitoring for 45m to ensure no functional regressions.

ops-runner: Soft cap remains notification-only. Email copy logged. OPS ticket updated with dedupe toggle notes.

fatima_csm: I'll run the enablement session Thursday, walk them through batching patterns, SDK knobs, and capture feedback on onboarding docs and SDK friction. If they accept recommendations we can present a commit rework with projected savings.

kevin_account_exec: Thanks  please ping before Thursday call so I can join if needed. Also prep renewal options: small commit bump vs consumption tier.

billing-bot: PROJECTION: With dedupe + paused backfill current projection $9,200. If usage remains <=$10k we can keep them on current commit without credit. Closing finance loop in FIN-7589.

jonah_csm: Action items: (1) Fatima run enablement + capture feedback, (2) Reno monitor metrics for 2h then revert if issues, (3) Ops keep soft cap notification active until EOD Fri, (4) Kevin prepare renewal options. Will update thread after Thursday call. :white_check_mark:
